notes.title: Mods and Some Reworks
notes.content:
[h1]New things[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added a new sink for meta currency that you can use in base camp once you’ve unlocked hardmode that lets you exchange meta currency for up to 3 perks that will affect your next run.
[/list]

[h1]Reworks[/h1]
[list]
[*] Reworked some of entrepreneur passives
[*] Made the passive that converts money to auto attack damage have a chance to trigger now instead of all the time (100% → 25%)
[*] Replaced one of the critical chance increase passives with a new passive that converts crit damage over 2x to critical chance
[*] Replaced the critical damage increase passive on the rogue tree with a new passive that increases parties defense by 10% for 5 seconds when critting
[*] Capped combo points per tokens skill so you can’t get 100s of combo points at once
[*] Swapped one of plaguebearers passives (the one that reduced cooldown on poison damage) or one that inflicted poison on crit. We felt the origional passive took away from strategic elements of the character, plus, the new passive allowed for more synergy with other classes.
[*] Lowered enemy health scaling from waves 10 to 20 as with some builds it felt like a bit too slow here even if they would eventually be good.
[/list]

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed clicker damage text sometimes covering level for young rodent
[*] Fixed shield indicators showing before wave 10 (weren’t actually affecting anything, just a visual issue)
[*] Fixed leaderboard not adding your score if you didn’t return to menu after the run
[*] fixed visual placement of stance hover panels which was causing them to flicker on some aspect ratios
[*] Fixed one of the achievements triggering incorrectly when you had no party members
[*] Fixed bug with equipment extra engine slot perk incorrectly removing slots on the engine when unequipping if you had more slots than 16
[*] Allowed the use of meta gameplay settings while cheesepad is open
[*] Fixed concoct potions healing a flat amount instead of the percent like they were saying.
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/RIyPGMD.gif[/img]

notes.title: Even More Visual Improvements & Achievements!
notes.content:
[h1]Visual improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added a preview pop up for skill combining to show the outcome
[*] Added base traits icon to the skills in the engine to help with planning synergies
[*] Made the invest button show what stats you'd get from investing
[*] Added the trait icon with the synergy text to help show what to look for
[*] Clarified a bunch of ability descriptions
[*] Shows merge cost when trying to merge skills or how much you are missing when you try to merge skills and don't have enough
[*] Added a way to see what investment buffs you've acquired
[*] Added more of an overview to each class to give an idea of what they specialize to hopefully help you decide who to pick when picking between characters
[/list]

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Compare mode with equipment with passive was getting funky and going off screen sometimes
[*] Fixed the shader when dragging equipment when you have multiple of the same type of equipment
[*] Fixed compare mode and equipment pop up not updating when switching character tabs
[/list]

[h1]New things[/h1]
[list]
[*] Enemies now have a chance to be spawned with a shield that makes them take 25% less damage from either physical or magical skills. You'll see the shield above the enemies head when they have this affect with either a sword or wand. This should incentivize experimenting with different builds and balancing builds a bit more, but if you don't like it, let us know!
[*] 5 new achievements, 1 of which is a hidden one.
[/list]

And as always, feel free to join our [url=https://discord.gg/2DqDBgTMEs]Discord[/url] if you have anything you want to see in the game!

notes.title: Small Visual Improvements & More Balancing
notes.content:
This is a small but important update as we planned on adding more visual improvements but realized the enemy scaling after wave 30 got over tuned too hard after last update. Look forward in the next few days to another update that will have a lot more visual enhancements! 

[h1]Rework[/h1]
[list]
[*] Reworked stock market price generation to be wave based instead of time based. This means the demand of items changes whenever the wave changes now
[/list]

[h1]Balancing[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed the reaper so it's health is as high as it should've been
[*] Fixed the enemy scaling after wave 30 so it doesn't one shot you (now enemies attack is 2*wave count)
[*] Slightly turned down enemy attack speed
[*] Turned down concoct potions heal amount from (30% to 15%)
[/list]

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed spending more on cosmetics after you've unlocked all of them
[*] Fixed metalheads sprites matching his sub classes
[/list]

[h1]Visual Improvements (Just a start)[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added numbers below character buttons in cheese pad to help remind that you can use numbers to switch tabs
[*] Made the level text placement consistent across characters (specifically, moved young rodents level text to match party members)
[*] Added sell value of equipment to the equipment pop up so now you know how much they will sell for
[*] Changed equipment titles color and gave it a wavy effect if it has a passive on it to help show it being a higher rarity
[/list]

Remember to keep a look out for another visual update soon! And as always, join our [url=https://discord.gg/2DqDBgTMEs]Discord[/url] if you have ideas for skills, passives, achievements, or other mechanics you'd like to see added or changed!

notes.title: Even More Bug Fixes & Balancing!
notes.content:
[h1]Fixes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed desc on steam vent skill
[*] Fixed the auto clicker meta description
[*] Fixed an issue with swapping screens while investing
[*] Fixed an issue with the skill bar sometimes having one too few slots
[*] Fixed skill bar organization so it shows casters name instead of class and also made the text auto size so it doesn’t get cut off
[*] Fixed cap on engine slots so it actually is 16 now.
[*] Fixed the hardmode toggle
[*] Fixed tinkerers double shield ultimate incorrectly multiplying only the casters shield.
[/list]

[h1]Balancing:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Made rogues burst ability synergize with rogue trait
[/list]
[b]Whizzard:
[/b][list]
[*] Added two new passives to whizzards first tree and 1 new passive to the second tree to give give him more support for dodge builds that also works with other builds
[*] Passive: On dodge, 50% chance to concoct potions
[*] Passive: On dodge, 50% chance to increase crit chance by 25% for 4 seconds.
[*] Passive: On crit, cast liquid cooled
[/list]

[b]MetalHead[/b]
[list]
[*]Buffed shield tree to generate more initial shield (hopefully making metalhead stronger early game)
[*]Made more of the tanks' skills have synergies.
[*]Fixed one of its skills so that it works properly which should make it work a lot stronger.
[*]Improved Armor ups shield amount.
[*]Reduced ultimate's cooldown
[/list]

[b]Inhalant[/b]
[list]
[*] Moved the inhalant trees around as we found the bomb build was really fun early game, but kind of dropped off later and wanted to give it its time to shine. We also buffed the bomb tree.
[*] Made base bombs scale with (100% → 150% attack stat)
[*] Made cluster bombs scale with (100% → 125% attack stat)
[*] Improved all bombs base damage
[*] Increased the passive that increased bombs base damage (+5 → +20)
[/list]

[b]Raider:[/b]
[list]
[*] Reduced passives that increased ammo clips from (4 → 2).
[*] Fixed descriptions on passives that gave bullets a chance to add effects (description was just wrong, but chances stay the same).
[*] Reduced starting ammo count in a few of it’s weapons.
[*] Made it’s ultimate only apply 1 stack of burn at a time.
[/list]

[b]Martyr[/b]
[list]
[*] Made the death heal only up to 50% of their max health rather than adding 50% of their max health.
[*] Mad critical heal only heal (5% → 2%).
[/list]

[b]Mad scientist[/b]
[list]
[*] Ult duration from (10 → 6).
[*] Fixed it so debuffs on enemies can only debuff stats that are actually relevant which should make the mad scientist way stronger.
[/list]

[h1]Discord[/h1]
If you have any more feedback, we would be happy to add it to the game! Just let us know in our [url=https://discord.gg/2DqDBgTMEs]discord[/url]!
https://discord.gg/2DqDBgTMEs

notes.title: Running In The Background (and more balancing)
notes.content:
[h1]New things[/h1]
[list]
[*] Made it so the game runs even while tabbed out (thanks to some helpful feedback we received!)
[*] Added a button in game to take you to our discord if you have any suggestions
[/list]

[h1]Balancing/Tweaks[/h1]
[list]
[*] Increased enemy health and decreased enemy damage even more after wave 20. After beating the final boss, enemies scaling increases a lot more now too
[*] Added 1 new generic skills that can be found in booster packs (gnaws compliment) which should give more buffing and crit team comps support
[*] Made more of the inhalant classes skills the hotrod trait which should make that class feel a lot more satisfying after unlocking the skill combiner

[b]Tweaked raider:[/b]
[*] Reduced passive that gave chance to generate ammo (25% → 10%)
[*] Reduced chance for bow to generate ammo from (30% → 20%)
[*] Reduced chance for blow dart to generate ammo from (25% → 15%) and decreased its starting ammo amount from (7 → 3)

[b]Tweaked Martyr class:[/b]
[*] Increased passives that made enemies target the martyr(10% → 15%), as well as increased passives that gave martyr a chance to take hit for ally (6% → 10%)
[*] Reduced martyrs death heal from (75% → 50%) max health
[*] Replaced one of the weaker damage buff passives on the martyr with a new passive that lets him heal your weakest allies when he crits
[*] Replaced one of the early defense passives with a new passive that gives 3 random allies potions on death which should give him more combo potential with the mad scientist
[/list]

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed a hidden achievement not activating when it should (woops)
[/list]

Also check out some of the youtubers playing our game! So cool!
[url=https://youtu.be/0DaJkBsPOfY?si=6hX2duYrp_IJCBkl]Super Auto Gaming[/url]
[url=https://youtu.be/UkLBeAWchWo?si=KN0MEqYLrVRfOeDm]LucksOut[/url]
[url=https://youtu.be/3QbNI5-FkA4?si=rn8s2IyfuFa8IJGG]MN Indie Games[/url]

notes.title: Steam Leaderboards, Balancing, & Bug Fixing
notes.content:
[b]New Things[/b]
[list]
[*] Added an online leaderboard so you can compete and see how far people have been able to get.
[*] Added a place to spend coins and extra equipment (and by extension, tokens), where you input in equipment and pay coins to give your party bonuses for that run based on what you put into it. (add tutorial and juice)
[*] Reworked skill bar so it sorts the skills based on the caster.
[*] Another new hidden achievement
[/list]
[b]Reworks[/b]
[list]
[*] Reworked how tokens are dropped. Instead of dropping a ton late game causing the focus to be more on opening packs late game rather than building the engine and watching it go, the tokens now drop more in the early game and slightly drop off late game (we are experimenting with this though, so let us know what you think!)
[*] Lowered the max enemies per wave cap. Instead of capping at 20 enemies per wave, it’s now 15. To make up for this, we increased the enemy health scaling and reduced enemy damage increase after wave 10. This should hopefully make the focus more on combos and synergies late game rather than 1 or 2 strong skills.
[*] Similarly, we greatly increased the final boss's health, but reduced his damage to make him more a test of how well your build synergizes rather than if you just upgraded a few things to be really strong.
[*] Reworked irradiate so that if you reach 100% with it, it bursts and activates your skills. It felt weird reaching 100% (or even 1000% for that matter) and nothing crazy happened.
[*] Slightly reduced radiation chance on the mutants tree to account for the aforementioned buff.
[*] Made some improvements to the UI to hopefully take a step in the right direction in regards to readability. (stance buttons, added characters level to their panel instead of the stat window, replaced ‘character’ with their actual name in the stat window, etc)
[*] Tweaked Inhalant
[*] Reduced burn time on firebreath from (6 → 4)
[*] Reduced burn time on molotov from (3 → 1.5), but made the burn damage faster (.4 → .3)
[*] Reduced passive that burned enemy on respawns burn time from (3 → 2), and reduced its damage speed from (.4 → .5) 
[*] Tweaked plaguebearer
[*] Replaced plague time passive with a passive that reduces respawn time based on plague on enemy
[*] Replaced duplicate plague rush skill with a new passive that applies a deadly poison to the enemy when a health potion is used (there’s a crazy combo with this, see if you can find it).
[/list]
[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with the two achievements regarding meta upgrades not working
[*] Fixed an issue with skill hover display going off the screen for some monitors
[*] Fixed bug showing more status effects on the enemy than applied
[*] Fixed sprite generation for equipment (whoops)
[/list]

And don't forget to join our [url=https://discord.gg/2DqDBgTMEs]Discord [/url]if you have any ideas you'd like to see in the game!
https://discord.gg/2DqDBgTMEs
